answer: An agent economy resists sybils with renewal by past counterparties: each epoch, an identity keeps its right to earn only if several distinct customers it genuinely served before publicly confirm it, like a grove where each tree is vouched for by the neighbours it shaded. One customer may renew only a few identities per epoch, so a lagoon of fakes with no real customers finds nobody to confirm it. Each fake must first buy a genuine service history, paying full cost per fake, while an honest agent renews on work already done, trellis-strong and cheap.
